Hi Priya / George,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and clear product fit on the NovaCare side. Quick recap + proposed next steps from the security/compliance questions that came up during the demo: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II in June 2028 (scope: infrastructure + platform + deployment). We can provide the full report under NDA or a redacted copy plus a bridge letter for any gaps as of the report date.
- Bridge letter: we have a standard bridge-letter template we can share immediately; we can also issue a customer-specific attestation if you need it for procurement.
- Trust portal: we host a secure evidence portal (read-only) for customers to pull reports, certs, and artifacts. I can provision NovaCare with viewer access once you confirm the admin email.
- Vendor questionnaire (DDQ): I attached our vendor DDQ template to help you map fields back to our SOC2 report; happy to work through fields you care most about (GDPR / HIPAA / data residency).

Proposed next steps (if that works for you):
1) Priya/George to confirm the primary admin email to provision the trust portal.
2) I’ll share the redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF + bridge letter sample in the portal and as attachments.
3) If you want a copy of the full report, we can execute an NDA/DocuSign and deliver the report within 48 hours of signature.
4) Fill/return the attached DDQ where helpful — we’ll prioritize answers and schedule a short follow-up Q&A (30 min).

Attachments: redwood_security_one-pager.pdf (embedded in demo pack), vendor_ddq_template.xlsx

If that timeline looks good I’ll start provisioning access and loop in Kimberly to coordinate any legal/portal steps.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
